subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-19 (kb/Work PB532), EDITION-KEYED 2026-11-01 (kb/Work PB4304). "The maximum number of characters allowed in character-string-1 is 63" is the 2023 text's number, in force from COBOL-2014. The 2002 text's own 13.16.39.3 SR4 says 50 and its Annex F.2 item 94 records the increase "from 30 to 50", so COBOL-85 is 30 (GnuCOBOL cobol85.conf pic-length 30); the 2014 half was refuted as a 50 (cobol2014.conf pic-length 63 beside word-length 31; Annex E records the word-length increase but no picture-string increase), so 2014 = 2023 (VCR row 7.46, derived edge per owner decision R61). The bound is ONE function, PictureAnalyzer.MaxStringLength(dialectLevel), its two edges the constructs rows picture-string-50-2002 and picture-string-63-2014 read through ConstructRegistry.IsAvailable; Analyze's prologue measures character-string-1 AS WRITTEN (SR6's second sentence: the length of the integer, not of the constant-name, is counted; PIC X(30000) is four characters) after DataBinder.Constants.ExpandPicConstants has substituted every constant-name, and reports COBOL2146 naming the edition's bound and where 63 begins; a length error, so also under --permissive. MEASURED: 31 written X's draw COBOL2146 at --std 85 only, 51 at 85 and 2002, 64 at every edition; the 30-, 50- and 63-character boundaries compile at 85, 2002 and 2014 respectively.
